title: Just ok
text: Just ok. Not my favorite furniture piece from Amazon. I felt like this is nice for a guest room, but it didn’t seem like the greatest quality. A little cheap looking. Overall not horrible. We have it in a guest room so it works for us.

product_metadata.title: Ameriwood Home Adams Queen Headboard, Ivory Oak
features: Finish your bedroom with the Ameriwood Home Adams Queen Headboard
Made of laminated MDF and particleboard, the off-white woodgrain finish pairs with the decorative panels for a beautiful, mission style that looks like real wood
The Headboard fits most standard queen sized bed frames and features predrilled holes to make attaching a bed frame simple. Mattress and bed frame are not included
Complete your bedroom with the entire Adams collection for a coordinated look (each sold separately)
The Headboard ships flat to your door and requires assembly upon opening. Preassembled panels make assembly quick and easy. Assembled dimensions: 48.35”H x 65.35”W x 2.6”D
description: Give your bedroom a completed look with the Ameriwood Home Adam Queen headboard. This Mission style headboard features decorative panels for an upgraded and elegant look. The classic off-white woodgrain finish on the laminated MDF and particleboard enhances the Mission style and gives the look of real wood for a fraction of the cost. The headboard fits most standard sized Queen bed frames and features predrilled holes to make attaching the headboard Simple and easy. Mattress and bed frame are not included. Pair the headboard with the rest of the Adam collection for a coordinated look (Each sold separately). The headboard ships flat to your door and requires assembly upon opening. Preassembled panels make assembly quick and easy. Once assembled, the headboard measures to be 48.35”H x 65.35”W x 2.6”D.

details.Product Care Instructions: Dust and wipe with a dry cloth and if needed, a damp cloth may be used sparingly.
